# AiGrid

> AiGrid is a browser JavaScript data grid (editable data table, spreadsheet-like grid) for plain JavaScript and React. It provides cell editing with 12 column types, change tracking, validation, undo/redo, Excel-compatible copy and paste, sorting, filtering, grouping, tree grid, summary rows, client and server paging, virtual scrolling for 500,000+ rows, and CSV/Excel import and export. Version 0.2.1, freeware: free for personal and commercial use; selling AiGrid itself is not permitted.

Key facts:

- Load `dist/aigrid-core.min.css` and `dist/aigrid-core.min.js`, then call `await AiGrid.createGrid({ mount, columns, dataSource, features })`.
- React: `import { AiGridReact } from "aigrid/react"` after `import "aigrid/core.css"; import "aigrid/core";`. Install with `npm install github:rubyonsoft/DataGridAI#v0.2.1`.
- Column types: rowno, row-check, text, multitext, number, date, check, radio, combo-master, combo-detail, template (DOM node renderer), button.
- Change tracking: `getChanges()` returns `{ inserted, updated: [{ row, dirtyFields }], deleted }`; `acceptChanges()` / `rejectChanges()`.
- Validation: column `validation: { required, pattern, min, max, custom }`, `validateAll()`.
- Data sources: local arrays, JSON URLs, server mode GET queries (`offset`, `limit`, `sort`, `filters`, `filterMode`), NDJSON, custom async `transport`.
- Cell values are always rendered as text (no HTML injection); structured cells use `cellTemplate` returning DOM nodes.
- Excel features require SheetJS (`window.XLSX`). Not included: charts, spreadsheet formulas, AI page builder.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/rubyonsoft/DataGridAI/blob/main/README.md): Overview, quick start for JavaScript and React, license summary
- [Features](https://github.com/rubyonsoft/DataGridAI/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md): Every feature with option and method names (Korean, with an English summary)
- [API reference](https://github.com/rubyonsoft/DataGridAI/blob/main/docs/API.md): createGrid options, feature flags and defaults, column properties, instance methods, events, React props
- [TypeScript types](https://github.com/rubyonsoft/DataGridAI/blob/main/dist/react/aigridTypes.d.ts): AiGridOptions, AiGridColumn, AiGridInstance, AiGridEventMap

## Examples

- [Live JavaScript examples](https://rubyon.azurewebsites.net/sample/example.html): 37 samples with editable code (column types, sort and filter, caption menu, grouping, tree, large data, server mode)
- [Live React examples](https://rubyon.azurewebsites.net/sample/react/index.html): Employee CRUD with validation and save, Column Types, Sort & Filter, Caption Menu, Grid Resize, Large Data Grid (500,000 rows)
- [Product page](https://rubyon.azurewebsites.net/software/aigrid): AiGrid introduction
